content.title: Harry Potter TV Show Cast: See Photos Of Who's Playing Who
content.text: Harry Potter TV Series Actors: Photos Of Who’s Playing Harry, Ron & Hermione L-R: Dominic McLaughlin and Alistair Stout; Ronald Weasley (Top) and Daniel Radcliffe (Bottom) as Ron Weasley and Harry Potter HBO Max/Everett The new Harry, Ron and Hermione have all been cast. Dominic McLaughlin will portray The Boy Who Lived, Harry Potter himself. Alastair Stout will play Harry’s best friend Ronald Weasley and Arabella Stanton will round out the classic trio of heroes as bookworm Hermione Granger, who is known in the books and movies as the smartest witch of her generation. RELATED: ‘Harry Potter’ TV Series Due To Hit HBO In 2026: Everything We Know About The Cast, Who’s Creating It, What J.K. Rowling Says & More Additionally, Paapa Essiedu has been cast as Severus Snape, Janey McTeer as Professor McGonagal and John Lithgow as Albus Dumbledore. Scroll through the gallery below to see photos of the new actors as well as their predecessors (in character) for comparison. Photo : Everett Collection/HBO MaxDaniel Radcliffe as Harry Potter and Dominic McLaughlinDaniel Radcliffe is shown here in ‘Harry Potter and The Sorcerer’s Stone’ (2001). Dominic McLaughlin will take up the mantle of “The Boy Who Lived” in HBO’s upcoming TV series.Photo : Everett/HBO MaxEmma Watson as Hermione Granger and Arabella StantonEmma Watson played Hermione Granger in the films, and she is pictured here in ‘Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone’ (2001). Arabella Stanton will portray the smartest witch of her generation in HBO’s upcoming TV series.Photo : Everett Collection/HBO MaxRupert Grint as Ron Weasley and Alistair StoutRuper Grint portrayed Ronald Weasley in the films, and above he is pictured in ‘Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone’ (2001). Alistair Stout will play the red-headed hero in HBO’s TV series.Photo : Everett Collection/Ruth CraferAlan Rickman as Severus Snape and Paapa EssieduAlan Rickman played Severus Snape, head of Slytherin House and potions master, in the films, and above he is pictured in ‘Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone’ (2001). Paapa Essiedu will portray Snape in the television series.Photo : Everett Collection/Shane NelsonMaggie Smith as Professor McGonagal and Janet McTeerMaggie Smith portrayed head of Gryffindor House and transfiguration teacher Minerva McGonagal in the films (pictured above in ‘The Sorcerer’s Stone’), and Janet McTeer will play her in the show.Photo : Everett Collection/Alan Chapman/Dave Benett/WireImageRobbie Coltrane as Rubeus Hagrid and Nick FrostRobbie Coltrane portrayed Hagrid, keeper of grounds at Hogwarts, in the films. He can be seen above in ‘Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone’ (2001). Nick Frost has been in negotiations for the role in the show.Photo : Everett Collection/Getty ImagesL-R: Richard Harris and Michael Gambon as Albus Dumbledore and John LithgowRichard Harris portrayed Hogwarts Headmaster Albus Dumbledore in the first two films – ‘The Sorcerer’s Stone’ (pictured) and ‘The Chamber of Secrets, and Michael Gambon took up the mantle in ‘The Prizoner of Azkaban’ (pictured) and beyond. John Lithgow will fill those big shoes in the show.Photo : Warner Bros./Carla WordenL-R: Tom Felton as Draco Malfoy & Lox PrattLox Pratt will portray Draco Malfoy, who was originally played by Tom Felton in the eight films.Photo : Warner Bros./Autumn de WildeL-R: Jason ISaacs as Lucius Malfoy in the ‘Harry Potter’ Films and Johnny FlynnJohnny Flynn will portray Lucius Malfoy, who was played by The White Lotus Season 3 alum Jason Isaacs in the films.Photo : Warner Bros/Sam IronsL-R: Julie Walters as Molly Weasley in the ‘Harry Potter’ films and Katerine ParkinsonKatherine Parkinson will play Molly Weasley, who was portrayed by Julie Walters in the films.Photo : Warner Bros./Getty ImagesL-R: Fiona Shaw as Petunia Dursley in the ‘Harry Potter’ Films & Bel PowleyBel Powley will portray Petunia Dursley, one half of the Muggle couple who take Harry in when he is orphaned. Aunt Petunia is a nosey neighbor and not fond of Harry’s magical tendencies.Photo : Warner Bros./GettyL-R: Richard Griffiths as Uncle Vernon Dursley in ‘Harry Potter’ films & Daniel RigbyDaniel Rigby will play Harry’s Uncle Vernon Dursley, who was played by Richard Griffiths in the films.Photo : Everett/Courtesy of HBOL-R: Matthew Lewis as Neville Longbottom and Rory WilmotMatthew Lewis portrayed Harry, Ron and Hermione’s fellow Gryffindor student in the films, and Rory Wilmot will play him in the TV show.Photo : Everett/Courtesy of HBOL-R: Harry Melling as Dudley Dursley and Amos KitsonHarry Melling played Dudley Dursley, Harry’s muggle cousin, in the films. Amos Kitson will portray him in the show.Photo : Everett/Courtesy of HBOL-R: Zoë Wanamaker as Madame Hooch and Louise BrealeyZoë Wanamaker played Madame Rolanda Hooch, the broom-flying instructor and Quidditch referee, in the films. Louise Brealey will play her in the show.Photo : Everett/Courtesy of HBOL-R: John Hurt as Garrick Ollivander and Anton LesserJohn Hurt portrayed Garrick Ollivander, wand connoisseur, in the films. Anton Lesser will portray the wizard in the television series.Photo : L-R: Gracie Cochrane as Ginny Weasley, Tristan and Gabriel Harland as Fred and George Weasley and Ruari Spooner as Percy WeasleyL-R: Gracie Cochrane as Ginny Weasley, Tristan and Gabriel Harland as Fred and George Weasley and Ruari Spooner as Percy WeasleyGracie Cochrane will portray Ginny Weasley, seventh sibling and only daughter in the family. Tristan and Gabriel Harland will portray her mischievous twin brothers Fred and George, and Ruari Spooner will portray their older brother Percy. In the films, Bonnie Wright played Ginny, James and Oliver Phelps played Fred and George and Chris Rankin portrayed Percy.
